visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a minimalist white environment, a girl with vibrant red hair and a white tank top crouches beside a pink pet bowl overflowing with green broccoli and a single carrot. Bugcat Capoo, a blue six-legged creature, stares at the vegetables with a look of extreme displeasure and refuses to eat. (2) Capoo is seen wearing a white chef's hat, diligently reading a red cookbook while stirring a sizzling pan of food on a small stove. The scene transitions to Capoo wearing a black gas mask while vigorously whisking a yellow mixture in a large bowl, surrounded by bottles of oil and various ingredients. (3) Capoo serves the prepared green meal to a small gray mouse sitting at a white-clothed dining table. The mouse consumes the food with incredible speed, its eyes turning into sparkling stars as its body rapidly expands and grows larger with every gulp. (4) The mouse becomes massive, dwarfing the room and Capoo. Capoo stands nearby, looking proud of the culinary success. (5) The scene returns to the girl and Capoo; the girl is overjoyed to see the pink bowl completely empty, clapping her hands. Capoo suddenly produces a small, personified gray poop character with a face. (6) Capoo feeds a wedge of yellow cheese to the small poop character, and both creatures express immense joy as pink hearts float around them in a bright, cheerful finale.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a whimsical, high-tempo synthesizer BGM that establishes a comedic tone. Capoo emits several high-pitched squeaks and grunts of protest, which are synchronized with the visual rejection of the vegetables. (2) A sharp transition effect leads into a layer of sizzling pan noises and bubbling liquid sound effects as Capoo cooks. These SFX are crisp and prominent against the ongoing bouncy music. (3) A series of rapid, percussive 'crunch' and 'gulp' sound effects occur as the mouse eats. The intensity of these effects increases in volume and frequency, matching the mouse's physical expansion. (4) A loud, comically exaggerated burp sound dominates the track, followed by a momentary dip in the BGM volume to emphasize the impact. (5) Bright, sparkling chime SFX and high-pitched 'ta-da' musical cues play as the empty bowl is revealed. Capoo makes happy, rhythmic chirping sounds. (6) A distinct 'squish' or 'plop' sound effect accompanies the appearance of the poop character, followed by a final cheerful chime and a melodic resolution of the synthesizer BGM.
